title: How I can help
subtitle: You know up front what I do and what it costs. No surprises on the invoice.

items.title: Managed IT care
items.description: A subscription that keeps your IT under control. I reply to a request within 24 hours. I advise, keep documentation current and maintain a yearly hardware-replacement plan, and I cover for your IT person while they're on holiday. I work as a consultant — the server, data and hardware stay your property.

items.title: Infrastructure projects
items.description: A concrete project with a clear result: architecture that doesn't fall over at the first failure, backups following the 3-2-1 rule, migration to new hardware. You pay for the outcome, in instalments — and you know up front what you get.

items.title: Automation & AI
items.description: I hand repetitive office work over to the computer, so no one loses hours on it. I bring in AI tools where they genuinely save time — without pushing trendy solutions for their own sake.

items.title: AI training
items.description: Hands-on training in AI tools for teams — for developers and non-technical people alike. Straight to things you'll use the next day, instead of theory and slides.
